# Core organization ontology

> Vocabulary for describing organizational structures, specializable to a broad variety of types of organization.

- Ontology IRI: http://www.w3.org/ns/org#
- Namespace: http://www.w3.org/ns/org# (prefix `org:`)
- Version: 0.8
- License: http://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/pddl/1.0/
- Contents: 9 classes, 31 object properties, 2 datatype properties, 1 property, 1 annotation property, 1 named individual

Terms are identified by IRI; use the CURIEs and labels below when writing SPARQL or RDF.

## Documentation

- [Overview](index.md): metadata and contents
- [Classes](classes.md): 9 classes with definitions and axioms
- [Object properties](object-properties.md): 31 object properties with definitions and axioms
- [Datatype properties](datatype-properties.md): 2 datatype properties with definitions and axioms
- [Properties](properties.md): 1 property with definitions and axioms
- [Annotation properties](annotation-properties.md): 1 annotation property with definitions and axioms
- [Named individuals](individuals.md): 1 named individual with definitions and axioms

## Machine-readable

- [ontology.json](ontology.json): all terms as JSON (IRI, label, definition, hierarchy, domain/range)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete documentation as one Markdown file
- [Turtle](ontology.ttl): the ontology source (text/turtle)
- [RDF/XML](ontology.owl): the ontology source (application/rdf+xml)
- [JSON-LD](ontology.jsonld): the ontology source (application/ld+json)
- [N-Triples](ontology.nt): the ontology source (application/n-triples)
